src/leaderboards/export.rs.description: LeaderboardExporter pattern for JSON/CSV export with Arc<Database>, export structures, and ExportError enum. Use this as template for AnalyticsExporter.

src/storage/analytics_store.rs.description: AnalyticsStore provides all data loading methods: load_pdc(), load_current_cp_model(), load_training_load_history(), load_current_vo2max(), load_rider_profile(). Uses rusqlite Connection reference.

src/metrics/analytics/export.rs.description: PdcExport.to_csv() method exports PDC data to CSV format with headers 'duration_secs,power_watts,achieved_at'. AnalyticsExporter.export_pdc_csv(user_id) loads PDC from database and returns CSV string. Returns InsufficientData error if no PDC exists.
